title: hieracium praecox subsp. subortum
intro: Hieracium praecox subsp. subortum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to reduce swelling and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include its ability to stimulate the immune system and act as an antipyretic, helping to reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to have anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
